name: Video Embed Spotify
description: Spotify provider plugin for Video Embed Field: recognises open.spotify.com URLs and renders the Spotify embed iframe player.
project_description: This module provides a Spotify handler (provider plugin) for Video Embed Field. It recognises open.spotify.com share URLs — track, album, artist, playlist, show and episode, plus legacy embed and user URLs — and renders the corresponding Spotify embed iframe. Remote thumbnails are fetched from Spotify's oEmbed endpoint. Requirements: Video Embed Field. Installation: install as usual, add a video embed field to a content type, check Spotify in the allowed content providers, then paste a Spotify Share » Copy link (starting https://open.spotify.com/) into the field.
